items.exampleEn: Raise your hand if you have a question.
He passed the ball to his friend.
Learning a language takes a lot of effort.
items.exampleZh: 學一種語言需要很大的努力。

items.exampleEn: Pull the door to open it.
items.exampleZh: 這扇門要用拉的才開得了。

items.exampleEn: I need to return this book to the library.
items.exampleZh: 我得把這本書還給圖書館。
你收到我的電子郵件了嗎？

items.exampleEn: I recorded the song on my phone.
items.exampleZh: 我用手機錄下了那首歌。

items.sentenceEn: I will return home next Friday.

items.questionZh: 說話的人今天收到什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The cafe raised its prices last month.

items.sentenceEn: We need your support for this plan.
items.sentenceZh: 這個計畫需要你的支持。

門不要用推的，要用拉的。

items.passageEn: Last year, Tom started learning the guitar. It took a lot of effort. Every day, he recorded himself playing and listened carefully. He made many mistakes, but his family gave him a lot of support. Last month, he played at a small concert. When he finished, people raised their hands and cheered. "I will return next year with new songs," he said.
items.passageZh: Tom 去年開始學吉他，付出了很多努力。他每天都把自己彈的錄下來，再仔細聽。他犯了很多錯，但家人給了他很多支持。上個月，他在一場小型音樂會上表演。他彈完的時候，大家舉起手來歡呼。他說：「我明年會帶著新歌再回來。」

options: 每天晚上去看別人在台上表演
把自己彈的錄下來再仔細聽

rubricZh: 「收到」用過去式（例如 received；寫 got 也正確）

items.promptZh: 他昨天把向我借的錢還給我了。
referenceEn: Yesterday he returned the money he had borrowed from me.
Yesterday, he returned the money that he borrowed from me.
rubricZh: 用 return 表示「歸還」，昨天的事用過去式（例如 returned）
「向我借的錢」可寫，例如 the money he borrowed from me、the money that he borrowed from me 等
寫 returned the money to me、returned my money 也正確
